entries.heading: Aressco Services, Inc.
entries.role: Founder (incorporated Aressco, Inc. in 1979, per the company's About page)
entries.found: Company careers page (seen 2026-11-17, undated) says it is 'looking for like-minded, dynamic individuals to join our rapidly expanding team' and lists current vacancies: Installation Technicians (5+ years, FASA or BASA), Service Technicians (5+ years, FASA or BASA) and Technician Apprentice (basic electronics, willing to learn). Applications by email or fax. Office: 16115 SW 117th Ave, Suite 26A, Miami 33177. The About page says Aressco runs its own UL-listed central monitoring station in South Miami-Dade ('one of the last truly local central stations in South Florida'), serves homes and businesses, and descends from Aressco, Inc. of Kendall (1979) and Assured Security Company of Homestead (1974). Product lines on the site: Alarm.com, Honeywell Total Connect, Qolsys, DMP, Uniview video.
entries.why: Owner-run, 45-year South Dade dealer with its own monitoring center and Homestead roots (a preferred zone), hiring install and service techs plus an apprentice: it is growing and already earns recurring monitoring revenue that IRIS can attach to. Video (Uniview) and commercial accounts are part of the mix.
entries.next_step: Approach as reseller (top tier): pitch to the owner as a monitored-video add-on for its commercial and Homestead/South Dade accounts; its central station is a natural place to bundle IRIS.

entries.heading: Security 101 - Miami
entries.role: Branch Manager (named on the company's Miami office page, not on the job post)
entries.found: Security 101's careers index (seen 2026-11-17) lists an Account Executive opening for the Miami office (also one for Fort Lauderdale). The Miami AE post offers $130k on-target earnings (base plus uncapped commission), a car stipend, and asks for 5+ years of B2B enterprise security sales, $1M+ annual sales, and a record of selling multi-year recurring-revenue (RMR) contracts to mid-market and Fortune 1000 clients in healthcare, education and manufacturing; vendors named are Axis, Genetec, Lenel, Software House and Exacq. A Miami Service Technician page (commercial electronic security service tech) is also still live at $28-$31/hour, asking for 2+ years servicing networked access control and IP video (Pro-Watch, Genetec, Software House, Lenel/S2, OpenPath; Axis, Exacq, Milestone, MaxPro, Victor, Avigilon, Hanwha), though it is not on the current careers index, so it may be filled. No posting dates are shown. The Miami office is at 2400 West 84th Street, Suite 15, Hialeah, and sells to healthcare, education (Safe Learning 101 for Schools), local government, property management and national accounts.
entries.why: Commercial-only integrator hiring a Miami sales rep whose comp plan is built around RMR contracts, which is exactly how IRIS is sold. It already does hosted video and proactive video monitoring (SiteGuard 101) and sells to schools and local government, the buildings where police camera access matters most.
entries.next_step: Approach the Miami branch manager as a reseller; pitch IRIS as an RMR add-on the new AE can carry into school and government accounts. Also check whether the Fort Lauderdale branch (same AE opening) wants it.

notes:
METHOD (2026-11-17). Sources used: Tallo city pages for alarm/security technicians and cable installers (Miami, Hialeah, Doral, Medley, Miami Gardens; these mirror Indeed posts with posted/expiry dates and Indeed job keys, which are cited as source_url); Talent.com public search pages (13 queries x 6 Miami-Dade locations, 433 unique cards, robots-allowed, 4 s between requests; mostly noise); Greenhouse public board API (first_published dates for Fortis and Titan), Lever postings API (Wachter createdAt), CareerPlug pages with JobPosting data (AT&I, iTekz), Kastle careers API, company career pages for 25 Miami-Dade firms from the IAF/manufacturer lists (robots checked), plus web search snippets. Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter and Glassdoor were not fetched directly (see below). Phone numbers were scrubbed from all raw scratch files.

COUNTS: 24 entries, 22 flagged Miami-Dade (AT&I = Cooper City/Broward and the Jobot confidential integrator = Fort Lauderdale are Florida but not Miami-Dade). Small/mid local firms: Aressco, Delphi One, Advance Security Group, Austen Fire and Security, Square Point Systems, Dade Electric Service, iTekz, Security 101 Miami (franchise-style branch), TSi Miami (new branch), AT&I. National/large firms noted briefly: Kastle, Pavion, Securitas Technology, Wachter, Titan Security Group, Fortis (IFSS), ADT, Brinks Home, Johnson Controls, Parsons, KBR, Wiginton. Roles: sales (Security 101 AE, Fortis AE, AT&I Enterprise AE/SDR, TSi AM, ADT consultant, JCI trainee, Jobot AE) and technicians/PMs (rest).

INTEL WORTH NOTING: Omni Data LLC dba Paradyme Secure (Miami-Dade IAF member) now describes itself on its Greenhouse board as 'Operating as part of the RapidSOS family of companies' (no current openings). RapidSOS works in the 911 data space, so this integrator may be a competitor channel rather than an IRIS reseller (https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/omni-data).
